correctness.rationale: For binary n=9 and at most one original-predecessor overwrite (including no error), the first bit is unchanged and global bit complement gives an isomorphism between its two 256-input halves; checked all 512 words exhaustively. In the leading-zero half the exact possible-output sets from bit-tuple overwrite yield a 256-vertex conflict graph with 2816 edges. The conflict edges are equivalent to pairwise intersection of possible-output balls. An independent SciPy 1.17/HiGHS 256-binary-variable MILP with all 2816 constraints solved globally with status 0, primal -39.000000000000064, dual -39.000000000000064, zero gap and 15,676 nodes (136.13 wall seconds), so under solver correctness the half-channel independence number is <=39. An independently reconstructed direct tuple-ball check finds 39 distinct witness half-words and 78 codewords after complement, all mutually disjoint, with 396 distinct received words. Thus the full optimum is 2*39=78. The finite exhaustiveness is at n=9 only. Checked all nine Git blob IDs on the current branch and independently recomputed their Git tree SHA equal to the assigned snapshot.
residual_risks: No independent machine-checkable rational MILP branch certificate; global bound relies on correct solver/ floating-point-integer-programming implementation. Integer optimum is separated from next integer by a unit, vastly larger than reported dual rounding (~1e-13).
The result is a finite optimum for one error at n=9 and does not establish other lengths, multiple grain errors, or asymptotic rates.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge priority assessment of the exact n=9, t=1 maximum, not of the model or generic bounding method. At the same channel and parameters Gabrys–Yaakobi–Dolecek arXiv:1307.7087v2, Table II, gives only 64 <= M(9,1) <= 112; Kashyap–Zémor supply general upper bounds and not an equality 78. A published complete M(6,1) extremizer census addresses a different blocklength. A particularly relevant 2015 Sharov–Roth article was found but its full text remained inaccessible; bibliography/abstract alone cannot rule out a prior exact value. No finding in the genuinely read primary material entails the claimed equality; unindexed exact computations remain a real priority risk.

value.rationale: This is a natural exact finite coding invariant: n=9 is the immediately following blocklength after the known n=8 exact size 44 in a standard physically motivated single-overwrite channel. The best inspected published table leaves a substantial 64-to-112 interval at the exact parameter. A 78-word construction paired with a complete 39-per-half upper computation supplies a precise benchmark and closes both sides of that gap; it is not a routine substitution, known-table recomputation, or arbitrary unmotivated restriction.
residual_risks: A specialized one-parameter computer-assisted invariant has narrower general reach than a symbolic family-wide theorem; no broader claim is made.
If earlier exact 78 appears in inaccessible 2015 literature, priority and this value comparison would require reevaluation.

limitations: Independent finite MILP is solver-dependent and not accompanied by a machine-independent integer certificate.
Sharov–Roth 2015 full text inaccessible with VPN disconnected; specific originality uncertainty retained, not misreported as a finding of no coverage.
Only a nine-bit, zero-or-one-error channel is proved.
